title: AWS Blog Detail Response
description: Output schema for `fetch_blogs.py detail` mode. An array of blog post details.

locale.description: Locale of the blog post (en_US or ja_JP).

dateCreated.description: Creation timestamp of the blog post (ISO 8601).

dateUpdated.description: Last updated timestamp of the blog post (ISO 8601).

url.description: Canonical URL of the blog post.

content.description: Full HTML content of the blog post.

error.description: Error message when the blog post could not be found.
